_handoff.scopeNote: Official-source pass for the default path only: an already registered Bengaluru birth and a request for a certificate/certified copy. Sources are limited to the current consolidated Registration of Births and Deaths Act PDF and an official Karnataka Chief Registrar/eJanMa public-interface snapshot. No login, OTP, identifier, document upload, payment, submission, or live record lookup was attempted. Name inclusion, correction, delayed registration, authenticity, rural-only routing, and non-default paths are out of scope.
_handoff.observationNote: The Act PDF is marked as on 2025-09-26 and directly supports sections 7, 8, 12, and 17. The Karnataka public-interface PDF is a dated 2024-11-14 capture of the Chief Registrar/eJanMa site; it records public links and office handoffs but does not prove current case-specific availability, fees, or output behavior in August 2026.

sources.title: The Registration of Births and Deaths Act, 1969 (as on 26 September 2025)
sources.notes: Direct Act PDF, not the India Code browse/index page. Sections 7, 8, 12, and 17 are the relevant provisions for local Registrar jurisdiction, reporting allocation, the free registration certificate, register search, and electronic/other certificate access.

sources.title: Births and Deaths — Office of the Chief Registrar of Births and Deaths, Government of Karnataka (public eJanMa site capture)
sources.publisher: Office of the Chief Registrar of Births and Deaths, Government of Karnataka (snapshot hosted by Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs)
sources.notes: The PDF capture is timestamped 11/14/24 12:15 PM. It records eJanMa public links for Download Certificate, Birth/Death Verification, and Application Status; says urban-local-body and BBMP events are registered by Health Officers/Health Inspectors; and directs additional-copy queries to concerned Nada Kacheri/data-entry operators or respective registration centres. It is not treated as a current August 2026 fee, SLA, or case-result guarantee.

claims.text: Section 7(2) requires each Registrar to enter information given under sections 8 or 9 for births and deaths that occurred in the Registrar's jurisdiction; section 7(3) requires an office in the local area for which the Registrar is appointed.
claims.notes: This establishes the statutory jurisdiction concept, not the particular ward/Registrar for an unknown record.

claims.text: Section 8 assigns reporting responsibility by place and circumstances, including the head of the house for a domiciliary birth and the medical officer in charge or authorised person for a hospital or similar institution birth.
claims.notes: The provision explains reporting allocation; it does not identify a current BBMP office for an individual record.

claims.text: Section 12 requires the Registrar, after registration is completed and not later than seven days, to give the person who supplied information under section 8 or 9 a certificate extracted from the register, electronically or otherwise under the Registrar's signature, free of charge.
claims.notes: The statutory seven-day/free first-certificate rule is not a promise about a later duplicate/copy request, current portal delivery, or a particular case.

claims.text: Section 17(1) allows any person, subject to State rules including fees and postal charges, to cause a Registrar to search the birth-and-death register and obtain a birth certificate electronically or otherwise; section 17(2) requires certification by the Registrar or a State-authorised officer.
claims.notes: The Act leaves fees, search procedure, and delivery implementation to State rules/authorised systems; it does not establish that every historical Bengaluru entry is online.

claims.text: The official Karnataka Chief Registrar/eJanMa public-site capture lists public links for Download Certificate, Birth/Death Verification, and Application Status, and says births in urban-local-body and BBMP areas are registered in eJanMa by Health Officers and Health Inspectors in their respective areas.
claims.notes: Directly documented in a timestamped 2024 official-site capture; no live 2026 interface, identifier query, login, or download was performed.

claims.text: The official Karnataka Chief Registrar/eJanMa public-site capture directs requests for additional birth/death certificate copies to data-entry operators of the concerned Nada Kacheri and respective birth-and-death registration centres, and directs clarifications to the District Statistical Officer of the concerned district.
claims.notes: This is an official documented contact handoff, but the capture is dated 2024 and does not establish the current Bengaluru office name, contact details, fee, or response time.

claims.text: The current existence of a particular Bengaluru birth record, the identifier fields accepted by the current lookup, and the found/not-found/error response cannot be determined from this pass because no record identifier or search was entered.
claims.notes: No personal data, registration number, date, CAPTCHA, login, or authenticated/public query was used.

claims.text: The current Bengaluru duplicate/certified-copy fee, delivery channel, acknowledgement/status behavior, and case-specific issuance outcome are not established by the reviewed official sources.
claims.notes: Section 17 expressly makes fees/rules State-dependent, while the 2024 eJanMa capture only lists a Download Certificate link and office handoffs.
